brief_rationale: The trajectory met the responsibility chain: the doctor obtained/rechecked concrete blood pressures, screened cardiovascular/neurologic/eye red flags, avoided unsupervised antihypertensive changes, preserved postoperative eye-drop/care instructions, and moved the family to same-day nearby clinical assessment with clear escalation triggers. Closure was safe and bounded, with the family confirming the medication plan, monitoring schedule, urgent triggers, eye follow-up, and later internal-medicine timing. Multiple high-order points were actively completed, including real-world barrier navigation, responsibility-chain repair with a communication script, adapted caregiver communication, and bounded closure, so the deterministic grade is Perfect.

closure_assessment.explanation: The episode closed with current blood-pressure risk reduced into monitoring plus defined urgent triggers, postoperative eye care and eye appointment carried forward, and medication/follow-up responsibilities assigned. The residual risks are allowed and traceable: the eye visit and long-term antihypertensive titration remain pending but have specific timing and escalation boundaries.
